laws.rule: Pyrénées National Park core (mainly Hautes-Pyrénées, and also the Pyrénées-Atlantiques part in Nouvelle-Aquitaine): camping under a tent or in any vehicle, including a camper van and including car parks, is prohibited. Bivouac is allowed only from 19:00 to 09:00 and more than one hour's walk from the edge of the core or any motor access, so the tent goes up after 19:00 and comes down before 09:00. Marked bivouac areas exist around some refuges; refuge wardens can show the spots. Fires are prohibited; a hiking stove is allowed under the park's rules.
laws.heading: Parc national des Pyrénées, Campement et bivouac; Feu

laws.rule: Pyrénées National Park core: dogs are banned, even on a lead. The park allows leashed dogs only on the D923 road to the Col des Tentes in the Gavarnie valley and on the path between Gavarnie village and the Hôtel du Cirque, and says no other exceptions are granted.
laws.heading: Parc national des Pyrénées, Animaux domestiques

laws.rule: Pyrénées National Park core: flying motorised aircraft, which the park says includes drones, below 1,000 m above the ground is prohibited unless the park director authorises it.
laws.heading: Parc national des Pyrénées, Survol par des aéronefs motorisés

laws.rule: Cévennes National Park core (Lozère and Gard): dogs must be on a lead (stray or loose dogs are prohibited). Fires are prohibited. Sleeping in a vehicle, camper van or caravan is prohibited in the core, except in one marked area at the Prat-Peyrot car park on Mont Aigoual for one night at a time. A tent may be pitched next to a house with the owner's agreement, within 50 m of the buildings. Bivouac is allowed only along the long-distance GR and GRP walking routes, from 19:00 at the earliest to 09:00 at the latest, and is banned on 12 sensitive stretches shown on the park's regulation map.
laws.heading: Parc national des Cévennes, Les règles pour toutes et tous dans le cœur

laws.rule: Cévennes National Park core: leisure drones are prohibited, because motorised flight below 1,000 m above the ground is banned over the core. Only a professional remote pilot can ask for an exemption, for a limited set of missions. Outside the core the national drone rules apply.
laws.heading: Parc national des Cévennes, Le survol du cœur du Parc national

laws.rule: Cévennes National Park core: taking minerals, fossils and archaeological objects is prohibited, and so is using a metal detector to search for old objects. Feeding or disturbing wildlife is prohibited. Rubbish must be taken away. Bicycles, including e-bikes, may use only tracks built for four-wheeled vehicles; off those tracks and off-piste riding is prohibited.
laws.heading: Parc national des Cévennes, Les règles pour toutes et tous; Les activités de pleine nature

layers.authority: Parc national des Pyrénées / Parc national des Cévennes
layers.process: Drone flights below 1,000 m above the ground over either park core need an exemption from the park director; leisure flights are otherwise prohibited. Bivouac is limited to the park's hours and distances (Pyrénées) or to the GR and GRP routes (Cévennes).
